QLoRA is a method that initializes low-rank adapters (corresponding to alternating step T = 0 in LoftQ), while alternative approaches that first obtain the low-rank approximation and then quantize the weight still outperform QLoRA significantly, even though they are worse than the primary LoftQ version. 2 RELATED WORK

Quantization of LLMs. Quantization is a compression technique that reduces the bit width of the parameters and/or activations of LLMs to improve their efficiency and scalability (Xiao et al., 2023; Dettmers et al., 2022; 2023a).
